t: A fast, low-profile eight-core Linux board for home servers and edge AI.
steps: Buy the board from Hardkernel or ameriDroid. The kit includes a case and heatsink.
Get a 12 volt, 2 amp barrel jack power supply. USB-C does not power this board.
Download the Hardkernel Ubuntu image from the ODROID wiki.
Flash the image following the wiki steps.
Connect HDMI, a keyboard, and an Ethernet cable. Then power it on.
Update the system and run a Python script that reads the header pins.
Try the Rockchip RKNN examples to run a first AI model on the NPU.
meta: Open Code. From $200. A few stores.
